# Approximation comparison (generated by validation/compare_approximations.py)

c1 = 13/72 = 0.180556; c2 (Espinosa 2020 eq. 6.5) = -0.013644.
Entries: median |e| / max |e| (∞: the estimate is infinite at some point; the largest finite error and the
count of infinite cases are in the JSON file). e = (S_est - S_num)/S_num.

| controlled_cw1 | 16261 | 5654 | 10607 | 174 | 1 | 10432 | standard tier |
| controlled_tree | 16261 | 5067 | 11194 | 0 | 0 | 11194 | standard tier |
| exploratory_cw1 | 10100 | 8304 | 1796 | 4 | 93 | 1699 | standard tier |

| model_family | 17 | 0 | 17 | 0 | 0 | 17 | all model points (idealised potential; no Planck scale) |

Rows without a numerical action are stable points, points without a finite bounce, collocation failures, non-perturbative and invalid inputs (status counts in the JSON file). The 360 `cw1` collocation failures are classified by the shooting fallback (78 metastable, all Planck-sensitive; 282 no finite bounce); none of them enters the comparison.
